name: giftapi
description: Distilled GiftAPI Partner S2S API reference for AI Copilot usage in this repository. Compiled from openapi.json (Partner S2S API v1.1.0).

base_urls.note: Configured via GIFTAPI_BASE_URL env var. Sandbox orders do not charge real money.

authentication.note: All endpoints require Bearer token. Order creation ALSO requires X-Timestamp + X-Signature headers.

money_format.note: GiftAPI uses float USD — NOT minor units. Contrast with NicePay which uses integer minor units.

pagination.usage: Pass cursor value as ?cursor= query param to get next page. null cursor means no more pages.

order_signature.description: Required for POST /orders only. Two extra headers must be sent.

example.note: Concatenate without separators. GIFTAPI_SECRET is the partner_secret from partner settings, NOT the Bearer token.

order_signature.important: GIFTAPI_SECRET (partner_secret) and GIFTAPI_TOKEN (Bearer API token) are TWO DIFFERENT credentials.

webhook_signature.idempotency: Each webhook has unique idempotency_key (UUID). Retried up to 3 times (10s, 100s backoff).

GET /me.description: Verify token, get partner info and balance

GET /catalog/products.description: Paginated product list with optional filters

query_params.type: voucher | recharge_fixed | recharge | voucher_open_range | esim | other
query_params.include_skus: boolean, include SKU list without pricing

GET /catalog/products/{uuid}.description: Full product detail with SKUs, pricing and stock

GET /catalog/pricelist.description: SKU prices and stock status (lightweight, no product metadata)

query_params.status: created | processing | completed | cancelled | failed | partially_completed

POST /orders.description: Create new order. Requires X-Timestamp + X-Signature in addition to Bearer token.
POST /orders.external_id_note: Must be unique across ALL your orders. Use as idempotency key.
POST /orders.fields_note: item.fields content depends on product.fields from catalog. For fixed vouchers: {quantity: 1}. For recharge: {amount: int, phone: str}.

error_codes.400: Business error (insufficient balance, out of stock)

product_types.recharge: Custom amount mobile top-up (requires amount + phone in fields)
product_types.esim: eSIM product, requires post-purchase status management

implemented: GiftAPI client with HMAC-SHA256 order signing (integrations/giftapi.py)
Catalog provider fetching products and categories (providers/giftapi_catalog.py)
GiftAPI service for overview, categories, products, orders, eSIM status (services/giftapi.py)
Telegram handlers for GiftAPI partner menu (handlers/giftapi.py)
Sandbox and production URL support via GIFTAPI_BASE_URL
not_implemented_yet: Webhook receiver for order status updates
Automatic order status polling / push-to-buyer notification
eSIM lifecycle management beyond status check

implementation_rules: Use GIFTAPI_TOKEN as Bearer token in Authorization header for all requests.
Use GIFTAPI_SECRET (partner_secret) ONLY for HMAC-SHA256 signing — it is NOT the Bearer token.
Order signature formula: HMAC-SHA256(str(timestamp) + sku_id + external_id, GIFTAPI_SECRET). Concatenate without separators.
external_id must be globally unique per partner. Use a stable local order/payment identifier.
Money is float USD in GiftAPI responses — do NOT convert to minor units for GiftAPI requests.
Pagination is cursor-based. Pass meta.next_cursor as ?cursor= for the next page. Null means end.
For webhook verification: HMAC-SHA256(timestamp + event + idempotency_key, GIFTAPI_SECRET). Tolerance ±5 min.
Before creating an order, check product.fields to know what item.fields to send.
For recharge products, item.fields must include amount (integer denomination) and phone.
Do not hardcode SKU UUIDs — always fetch from catalog.
Do not assume esim products are handled like vouchers — they need post-purchase ICCID tracking.
When ENABLE_GIFTAPI_PROVIDER=false, do not make any GiftAPI API calls.
Never commit GIFTAPI_TOKEN or GIFTAPI_SECRET — use .env and .env.example placeholder.
copilot_prompt_lines: Ты работаешь с интеграцией GiftAPI Partner S2S API в Python-проекте CERBER. Используй этот файл как рабочий reference.
GiftAPI использует Bearer token в заголовке Authorization для всех запросов.
Для создания заказа (POST /orders) дополнительно нужны заголовки X-Timestamp и X-Signature.
Подпись заказа: HMAC-SHA256(str(timestamp) + sku_id + external_id, GIFTAPI_SECRET). Конкатенация без разделителей.
GIFTAPI_SECRET и GIFTAPI_TOKEN — это РАЗНЫЕ credentials. Secret только для HMAC, Token только для Bearer.
Деньги в GiftAPI — float USD, НЕ minor units. Не конвертируй в копейки.
Пагинация курсорная: берёшь meta.next_cursor из ответа и передаёшь как ?cursor= в следующий запрос.
external_id заказа должен быть уникальным глобально. Используй как idempotency key.
Поля item.fields зависят от конкретного продукта — смотри product.fields из каталога.
Для recharge-продуктов item.fields содержит amount (integer, номинал) и phone (строка с кодом страны).
Статусы заказа: created, processing, completed, cancelled, failed, partially_completed.
Delivery данные (pin, expiration, serialNumber) доступны только когда статус completed.
Вебхук подпись: HMAC-SHA256(timestamp + event + idempotency_key, GIFTAPI_SECRET), допуск ±5 минут.
Вебхук должен вернуть HTTP 2xx за 10 секунд, иначе GiftAPI повторяет попытки (10s, 100s backoff).
Проверь ENABLE_GIFTAPI_PROVIDER перед реализацией функций — провайдер может быть отключён.
При изменениях переиспользуй существующие модули: integrations/giftapi.py, services/giftapi.py, providers/giftapi_catalog.py.
Sandbox URL: https://sandbox.giftapi.io/api/v1/partner — для тестов (деньги не списываются).
